urls.rationale: Act 472 of 1978 - Lobbyists, Lobbying Agents, and Lobbying Activities (MCL 4.411-4.431) is Michigan's Lobbyists Registration Act.

notes: Justia uses 'statute-act-472-of-1978' slug under chapter-4. Act 214 of 1947 (Legislative Agents, 4.401-4.410) is marked 'Repealed' and excluded. The chosen act covers the full MI lobbying-disclosure regime.
